ownerDependencies.SELECTED_AUTHORIZATION_PATH: Existing authorization owner must supply the canonical selected authoritySubjectPartyRef, path basis and exact action/rule/schema/contract selection. actingPartyRef and the act fixture expectation are not substitutes.
ownerDependencies.SUBJECT_SCOPE_RELATION: Typed immutable subject/anchor resolution and any required directed relation at the selected time and extent.
ownerDependencies.ASSERTION_ACT: Exact act owner checker over original content, intent, source, context, policy and profile bytes.
ownerDependencies.DOMAIN_MEANING: All source predicates and returned source roles for every recursive atom, not only intrinsic or selected-meaning equality.
ownerDependencies.CONTEXT_IDENTITIES_AND_RELATIONS: Every typed body context resolves at its exact selected identity and directed relation use time, without widening the sole authority anchor.
ownerDependencies.EVIDENCE_USE_AND_CITATION_CLOSURE: Typed role table, every selected original evidence record and its existing use/admission mechanism.
ownerDependencies.EVENT_OWNER: Exact pre-verdict Event Ingress checker; no later ingress result substitutes for it.
ownerDependencies.EVENT_DOMAIN: Complete selected event meaning, subject/anchor, time and body/payload comparisons.
ownerDependencies.PERFORMER_IDENTITY: Selected performer identity and source linkage, distinct from reporter and authority subject.
ownerDependencies.AGENT_ACTORSHIP: Existing agent actorship evidence for performed software-agent allegations.
ownerDependencies.PERFORMER_AUTHORITY_EVIDENCE: Actual optional evidence comparison; it never changes NOT_EVALUATED_BY_AUTHORIZATION.
ownerDependencies.OPERATION_SOURCES: Actual intent/execution sources plus every row-required source role.
ownerDependencies.COMPLIANCE_RULE_SELECTION: Exact selected governing rule revisions and their applicability predicates.
ownerDependencies.EVIDENCE_POLICY_SELECTION: Exact selected evidence-policy revisions and eligible-use predicates.
ownerDependencies.PRIOR_ASSERTION_CONTEXT: Storage-owner positive start-snapshot visibility plus subtype, boundary/twin, anchor and logical-subject comparisons.
ownerDependencies.PROTECTED_PROPOSED_STATE: Exact pre-verdict state-owner checker and binding to these original intent/result bytes.
ownerDependencies.TRANSACTION_GATE_SELECTION: Reviewed owner selection of the applicable later atomic gate and pre-verdict handoff predicate. This is not a receipt or proof of an already completed atomic commit.
ownerDependencies.RESOLVED_INPUT_CLOSURE: Every selected immutable input and original raw byte hash appears in the protected read set.
ownerDependencies.SUBJECT_TIME_SOURCES: Exact profile-specific source selectors, including independent measurement for PERFORMED_INSTANT.

sequence: domain payload and separate trace when implementation is complete
transactionConstraint: No earlier domain evaluation accepts or requires its own later receipt, checkpoint or trace. The pre-verdict handoff predicate needs exact owner review; state conformance alone is insufficient.
